name: Shirogane no Soleil -Successor of Wyrd- <<Unmei no Keishousha>>
original_name: 白銀のソレイユ－Successor of Wyrd《運命の継承者》－
source:
She is a battle heroine Valkyrie. There is an ancient ruin called Time Ship, in which Berserk is sealed tightly. But one day, Berserk comes back to destroy the world. A boy meets Valkyrie, and the story starts...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
她是战斗女主角——女武神。古代遗迹“时之船”中，狂战士一直遭到严密封印。然而有一天，狂战士复苏，企图毁灭世界。一名少年与女武神相遇，故事由此开始……

[摘自ErogeShop]
